description: Design and execute social/health research and apply the right methodology — conceptual & logic modeling, community-based participatory research (CBPR/YPAR), participatory and agent-based modeling, composite-index spatial analysis, implementation-science frameworks, measures/instrument design, and human-subjects protections (IRB/HRPP). Invoke whenever planning a study, building or expanding a conceptual model, choosing methods or an implementation framework (e.g. CFIR vs RE-AIM, Bowen feasibility), writing a human-subjects/IRB section, doing a literature synthesis, or reviewing research-ethics/HRPP/AAHRPP documents — e.g. "design this study", "expand the model", "which framework fits", "write the IRB section". Grounds recommendations in the researcher's own domains, populations, and collaborators when a local researcher profile is kept. Disambiguation: this skill owns study-design SUBSTANCE (methods, frameworks, ethics); for proposal structure and funder alignment use grant-writing; for scholarly wording and voice pair with a scholarly-voice/academic-writing skill if you keep one; for non-technical/business audiences use plain-language.
